abort.one_mapping_required: At least one thermostat mapping must remain.

error.confirmation_required: Confirm this physical thermostat or command-writer change.
error.duplicate_ecobee_source: This Ecobee climate is already mapped.
error.duplicate_mapping_name: Use a unique thermostat mapping name.

error.duplicate_homekit_source: This HomeKit climate is already mapped.
error.homekit_device_required: Select a HomeKit climate linked to a thermostat device.

error.invalid_ecobee_source: Select an entity supplied by Ecobee on the mapped Ecobee device.

user.description: Map at least one physical thermostat to create the unified surface.

mapping.description: Build one thermostat device surface. HomeKit owns local climate, preset, and clear-hold control; Ecobee owns vendor-only detail and actions.
mapping.title: Thermostat mapping

ecobee_notification_unavailable.message: The mapped Ecobee thermostat notification writer is unavailable, or the message is empty.

ecobee_writer_unavailable.message: The mapped Ecobee writer is unavailable.

homekit_writer_unavailable.message: The mapped HomeKit writer is unavailable; no fallback write was attempted.

invalid_fan_runtime.message: Minimum fan runtime must be between 0 and 60 minutes in five-minute increments.

invalid_humidity.message: The requested humidity is outside the mapped HomeKit climate's supported bounds.

invalid_occupancy_modes.message: Select at least one valid Ecobee occupancy policy.

invalid_sensor_selection.message: Select one or more distinct Ecobee sensor devices for this thermostat.

invalid_temperature.message: The requested temperature is outside the mapped HomeKit climate's supported bounds.

invalid_temperature_range.message: The requested low temperature must not exceed the high temperature.

invalid_vacation_name.message: Vacation names must contain 1 to 12 characters.

invalid_vacation_options.message: The vacation fan mode or minimum fan runtime is invalid.

invalid_vacation_period.message: Vacation dates and times must form complete pairs, and the end must follow the start.

invalid_vacation_temperature.message: Vacation temperatures must be finite numbers.

invalid_vacation_temperature_bounds.message: Vacation temperatures must be between {minimum} and {maximum} {unit}, as advertised by the mapped Ecobee climate.

invalid_vacation_temperature_range.message: The vacation heating temperature must not exceed the cooling temperature.

unsupported_command.message: The mapped HomeKit climate does not support this command.

unsupported_fan_mode.message: The mapped HomeKit climate does not support this fan mode.

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: The mapped HomeKit climate does not support this HVAC mode.

unsupported_preset_mode.message: The mapped HomeKit current mode select does not support this preset.

mapping_source_missing.description: The explicitly mapped {source} source, semantic contract, physical identity, or required device link is invalid or missing. Reconfigure this thermostat mapping; Ecobee Unified will not guess a replacement.
mapping_source_missing.title: A thermostat mapping needs attention

init.description: Freshness affects health, read fallback, and whether a cadence-backed Ecobee writer is safely usable. It never changes the selected writer or causes write failover.
init.title: Source timing
